notes: Alto Ingredients (NASDAQ: ALTO) — Sacramento-based ethanol + specialty alcohols producer (CIK 1076259, formerly Pacific Ethanol). Operates Pekin (IL) campus + Magic Valley (ID) + Columbia (OR) plants. ~350M gal/yr capacity. Three segments: Pekin (specialty + fuel), Marketing & Distribution, Western Production. Fiscal year = calendar. Reports in USD. Restructured 2024 — idled Magic Valley + Columbia, ICP Pekin sale processes. Significant operating losses post-2022.

periods.notes: FY20: revenue $906M. EBITDA $40M. Net income $90M (gain on plant sales offset losses).
FY21: revenue $1.18B. EBITDA $42M. Net income $21M. Renamed to Alto Ingredients (specialty pivot).
FY22: revenue $1.28B. EBITDA $30M. Net loss $3M. Margin compression on corn cost spike.
FY23: revenue $989M. EBITDA $-3M. Net loss $38M. CO2 supply contract delays + Pekin plant outages.
FY24: revenue $945M. EBITDA $-42M. Net loss $83M (asset impairments $40M+). Idled Magic Valley + Columbia. Strategic alternatives review for remaining assets.
